# LGD Demo Organization (lgd-demo-organization) — Full Text

This is the "full" companion to llms.txt, for long-context models that read the whole
repository description at once.

## What this is

A demonstration organization operated under the LGD three-law constitution
(Registry, Evidence, Gates). This repository is the publicly verifiable sample:
the claims it makes about its assets can be checked by any outside reader, without
trusting the operator.

One sentence: an open-source governance sample where every external claim carries
triple evidence, and a stranger can re-run the verification on a fresh clone.

## What problem it solves

1. You do not want to trust an operator's word about their own quality claims.
2. You want to independently re-run the checks behind a claim, not just read them.
3. You want a worked example of a "no self-certification" governance policy.

## The no-self-certification policy

Every external-facing claim is backed by three independent evidence layers:

1. Independent evaluator reports — written from an outsider's perspective, run on a
   freshly copied environment, never on the asset itself (`evidence/evaluations/`,
   `evidence/reverification/`).
2. Reproducible tooling — the same scripts the evaluator ran are archived under
   `evidence/tools/`; an outside reader can execute them and compare numbers.
3. External institutional time-stamps — claims deposited with an external registry
   carry a DOI or equivalent time-stamp no single party can backdate.

Honest boundary: this demonstration repository itself has not yet received a
DOI / SWH / arXiv deposit; the README says so rather than implying one.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization.git
cd lgd-demo-organization
python verify/run_verify.py
```

Read the printed table (PASS / FAIL / SKIP) and cross-check the cited numbers
against the source documents. Optional, with an external skills collection:

```bash
python verify/run_verify.py --skills-dir /path/to/skills-collection
```

## Trigger words

public verification / triple evidence / independent evaluation / reproducible
verification / governance sample / no self-certification / outsider re-check /
badge issuance register / gate-tracked release.

## Reproduction boundary

- Reproducible in one click inside this repository: archived tool self-checks,
  registry format validation, evidence-file integrity (existence, non-empty,
  certification keywords).
- Not reproducible from this repository alone: the full 113-skill AI-readiness
  scan and the 21/21 verified-agent-identity matrix. Those require the public
  skill collection and a Node.js environment.
